answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a systems thinking, emergent properties highlighted register, it stays short. Work waits on the walnut until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the garden of the next round. Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on automated market makers with concentrated liquidity.
